decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption. It utilizes powerful early game threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to quickly pressure the opponent. Thoughtseize and Terminate are used to disrupt the opponent's game plan while cards like Seasoned Pyromancer provide card advantage. The deck also includes cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect its creatures and maintain board presence. Overall, the goal of this deck is to apply constant pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on casting spells with Cascade ability to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption. By chaining spells with Cascade, such as Violent Outburst and Dead/Gone, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent and control the board. Additionally, cards like Shardless Agent and Murktide Regent provide additional threats and card advantage. The mana base is optimized to support the various colors needed for Cascade spells, ensuring consistency in casting powerful spells each turn.

The main idea of the deck is to control the game by using a combination of powerful creatures and spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck utilizes a mix of removal spells, disruptive planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler, and versatile creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Solitude to gain an advantage. The deck also includes a toolbox of utility creatures like Endurance, Titania, Protector of Argoth, and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to handle a variety of situations. The mana base is carefully designed to support the deck's color requirements and maximize efficiency.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to quickly overwhelm opponents. It also includes counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce to protect your creatures and disrupt your opponent's game plan. The deck is designed to be fast-paced and proactive, aiming to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure to your opponent. Additionally, card selection and graveyard interaction through cards like Mishra's Bauble and Thought Scour help you dig for key cards and power up Murktide Regent.

The deck focuses on cycling through the graveyard with cards like Architects of Will and Street Wraith to quickly fill it up, then casting Living End to bring back powerful creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Striped Riverwinder for a game-winning combo. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Negation to protect the combo, along with disruption cards like Grief and Shardless Agent. The goal is to set up a board state where the opponent is overwhelmed by high-value creatures and unable to recover, ultimately securing victory.

The deck focuses on using cycling creatures and spells to fill the graveyard with value, then casting Living End to bring back a board full of powerful threats for a lethal combo finish. By cycling through the deck efficiently and controlling the board with counterspells and disruptive creatures, the deck aims to set up a game-winning Living End play while keeping the opponent's threats at bay. With the ability to quickly assemble its combo and overwhelm opponents with a sudden influx of creatures, the deck offers a unique and powerful way to win games in the Modern format.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. It utilizes powerful cards like Tarmogoyf, Lightning Bolt, and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply pressure and control the board. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The combination of aggressive threats, removal, and disruption makes it difficult for the opponent to stabilize and ultimately leads to victory through a combination of early aggression and efficient removal.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on early-game disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, followed by efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push. Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide early pressure, while Seasoned Pyromancer and Wrenn and Six generate card advantage. Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Endurance disrupt graveyard strategies, while Fabled of the Mirror-Breaker provides additional card advantage. The deck can also close out games quickly with powerful threats like Liliana of the Veil and Den of the Bugbear.

This deck aims to utilize Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Ziatora's Proving Ground. By sacrificing tokens generated by Dwarven Mine or other spells, the deck can potentially win the game in just a few turns. It also includes cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Lightning Bolt for disruption and removal, while Persist provides resilience and recursion. The deck's strategy revolves around creatively combining cards to create explosive plays and overwhelm the opponent quickly.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful equipment combo using cards like Colossus Hammer, Puresteel Paladin, and Sigarda's Aid to equip creatures like Inkmoth Nexus or Ornithopter with huge damage potential. It also includes ways to tutor for key pieces like Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift. The deck utilizes Urza's Saga to search for artifacts, while also including protection and card draw options with cards like Shadowspear and Esper Sentinel. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces and deal overwhelming damage to the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to cheat powerful creatures into play by cycling through your deck and then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield from the graveyard. By using cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to cycle through your deck quickly, and utilizing spells like Violent Outburst to cast Living End for free, you can overwhelm your opponent with a sudden surge of high-powered creatures. This combo-centric strategy allows you to quickly take control of the game and secure a victory before your opponent has a chance to respond.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's game plan through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful planeswalkers. By efficiently removing threats and disrupting the opponent's plays, the deck aims to establish a dominant board presence with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation. The mana base is optimized to support a variety of colors for flexibility in casting spells. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion enhances the deck's strategy by providing additional synergy with the creature cards in the deck.

This deck focuses on using a variety of counterspells and removal spells to control the game, while also utilizing planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Jace, the Mind Sculptor for card advantage and board control. It also includes powerful creatures like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Solitude for added protection and win conditions. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and allow for flexibility in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through efficient control and strategic play.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity along with Dwarven Mine to bring out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Wrenn and Six. The goal is to set up a combo using Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and persist to control the board and quickly finish off the opponent. With the ability to disrupt the opponent's hand using Inquisition of Kozilek and deal direct damage with Lightning Bolt, this deck combines creativity and combo potential to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is utilizing the Puresteel Paladin along with Colossus Hammer and Sigarda's Aid to equip massive amounts of equipment onto creatures quickly, allowing for a fast and powerful attack. The deck also includes equipment such as Kaldra Compleat and Shadowspear to further enhance the damage output. Additionally, the deck includes Urza's Saga as a way to tutor for key pieces of the combo. The inclusion of cards like Springleaf Drum and Surge of Salvation help to support and protect the combo pieces.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of disruption and consistent damage output. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's hand, while also applying pressure with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, the deck aims to quickly close out games. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Terminate and Lightning Bolt provide removal options to handle threats from the opponent. With a streamlined mana base and versatile spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.
